zh: 看似只能从两端买书，其实限制并不强：任选偶数本书，总能用“先单买两端没选中的书，再合购最外侧两本选中的书”的方式全部合购。
所以只需决定合购次数 j；j 固定时，应把最贵的 2j 本用于合购，其余按原价购买。
价格降序排序并求总价；j 从 1 到 min(k, n/2)，累加前 2j 本的价格得 saved，候选费用 = 总价 − saved + j·pairCost，与 j=0 时的总价一起取最小值；用 64 位。
en: Buying only from the ends looks restrictive but is not: any chosen even-sized set of books can all be pair-bought by first buying the unchosen books at the ends one by one, then pair-buying the two outermost chosen books.
So you only need to decide the number j of pair purchases; for a fixed j, pair-buy the 2j most expensive books and buy the rest at full price.

Sort prices descending and compute the total; for j from 1 to min(k, n/2), let saved be the sum of the first 2j prices, the candidate cost is total - saved + j * pairCost; take the minimum together with the total for j = 0; use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the prices and enumerate the number j of pair purchases; pair-buy the 2j most expensive books, for a cost of the total minus the sum of those 2j books plus j*pairCost.

## Proof of correctness

Any chosen set with an even number of books can be pair-bought: first buy all unchosen books at the two ends individually, then pair-buy the two outermost chosen books, and repeat. So for a fixed j, pair-buying the 2j most expensive books is optimal, and enumerating j over 0..min(k, n//2) gives the optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
